description: This file defines the EnumResolver utility class, providing methods to convert strings to enum constants based on custom functions or naming conventions.

classes.name: EnumResolver
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to resolve enum constants from strings.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Converts a string to an enum constant of the specified class, applying a custom function to derive string representations.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string to an enum constant by matching the string (case-insensitive) to enum names.
